changed_in.5.2: Consults a `__pairs` metamethod and hands back what that answers, so a value can offer a traversal of its own and a value that is not a table can be walked at all; 5.1 always walks the table's own keys and accepts nothing but a table.
changed_in.5.3: Accepts any value without complaint and leaves the check to the walk's first step; 5.1 and 5.2 refuse a non-table at the call itself, so `pcall(pairs, 42)` reports a failure there instead of succeeding.
changed_in.5.5: Hands back a fourth value, the loop's closing value, and reads four results from `__pairs` rather than three; earlier versions hand back three and read three, so a metamethod's fourth result is ignored.
